from math import cos, pi, sin
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def regular_polygon(cx, cy, radius, vertices):
    points = []
    for index in range(vertices):
        angle = -pi / 2 + index * 2 * pi / vertices
        points.append((cx + radius * cos(angle), cy + radius * sin(angle)))
    return " ".join(f"{x:.1f},{y:.1f}" for x, y in points)


width = 1400
height = 1000
svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Paràmetres geomètrics d’un buffer</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Quatre seccions comparen el radi d’un buffer de punt, línia i polígon; un o quatre segments per quadrant; els extrems arrodonit, pla i quadrat; i les unions arrodonida, bisellada i en punta.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    "      .heading { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17242c; }",
    "      .label { font-size: 25px; font-weight: 700; fill: #263943; }",
    "      .note { font-size: 25px; fill: #4c606a; }",
    "      .separator { stroke: #aebcc3; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    "      .buffer { fill: #8fcde1; fill-opacity: .52; stroke: #176b92; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .buffer-stroke { fill: none; stroke: #8fcde1; stroke-opacity: .62; stroke-width: 76; }",
    "      .buffer-stroke-small { fill: none; stroke: #8fcde1; stroke-opacity: .62; stroke-width: 64; }",
    "      .source { fill: #d85f45; stroke: #873629; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .source-line { fill: none; stroke: #873629; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; }",
    "      .ideal { fill: none; stroke: #748791; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 7 6; }",
    "      .vertex { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #176b92; stroke-width: 2; }",
    "      .measure { fill: none; stroke: #c64c34; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .endpoint { stroke: #748791; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 6 5; }",
    "      .negative { fill: none; stroke: #c64c34; stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 7 5; }",
    '    </style>',
    '    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="8" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">',
    '      <path d="M0,0 L0,7 L9,3.5 z" fill="#c64c34"/>',
    '    </marker>',
    '  </defs>',
    '  <line x1="700" y1="20" x2="700" y2="470" class="separator"/>',
    '  <line x1="20" y1="490" x2="1380" y2="490" class="separator"/>',
    '  <line x1="700" y1="510" x2="700" y2="980" class="separator"/>',

    # Geometry and radius.
    '  <text x="30" y="43" class="heading">Geometria i radi d</text>',
    '  <text x="125" y="88" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Punt</text>',
    '  <circle cx="125" cy="220" r="72" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <circle cx="125" cy="220" r="9" class="source"/>',
    '  <line x1="125" y1="220" x2="194" y2="220" class="measure" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="157" y="207" class="label">d</text>',
    '  <text x="360" y="88" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Línia</text>',
    '  <path d="M 290,230 L 430,230" class="buffer-stroke" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
    '  <path d="M 290,230 L 430,230" class="source-line"/>',
    '  <line x1="360" y1="230" x2="360" y2="193" class="measure" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="372" y="216" class="label">d</text>',
    '  <text x="580" y="88" text-anchor="middle" class="label">Polígon</text>',
    '  <path d="M 520,135 H 640 A 35,35 0 0 1 675,170 V 270 A 35,35 0 0 1 640,305 H 520 A 35,35 0 0 1 485,270 V 170 A 35,35 0 0 1 520,135 Z" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <polygon points="520,170 640,170 640,270 520,270" class="source"/>',
    '  <polygon points="555,205 605,205 605,235 555,235" class="negative"/>',
    '  <line x1="580" y1="170" x2="580" y2="137" class="measure" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="592" y="158" class="label">+d</text>',
    '  <line x1="520" y1="220" x2="553" y2="220" class="measure" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
    '  <text x="523" y="254" class="label">−d</text>',
    '  <text x="125" y="353" text-anchor="middle" class="note">disc</text>',
    '  <text x="360" y="353" text-anchor="middle" class="note">franja</text>',
    '  <text x="580" y="353" text-anchor="middle" class="note">expansió / retracció</text>',

    # Segments per quadrant.
    '  <text x="730" y="43" class="heading">Segments per quadrant</text>',
    f'  <polygon points="{regular_polygon(900, 220, 82, 4)}" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <circle cx="900" cy="220" r="82" class="ideal"/>',
    '  <circle cx="900" cy="220" r="8" class="source"/>',
    '  <circle cx="900" cy="138" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <circle cx="982" cy="220" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <circle cx="900" cy="302" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <circle cx="818" cy="220" r="5" class="vertex"/>',
    '  <text x="900" y="338" text-anchor="middle" class="label">1 segment</text>',
    '  <text x="900" y="370" text-anchor="middle" class="label">per quadrant</text>',
    '  <text x="900" y="410" text-anchor="middle" class="note">4 vèrtexs</text>',
    f'  <polygon points="{regular_polygon(1190, 220, 82, 16)}" class="buffer"/>',
    '  <circle cx="1190" cy="220" r="82" class="ideal"/>',
    '  <circle cx="1190" cy="220" r="8" class="source"/>',
]

for index in range(16):
    angle = -pi / 2 + index * 2 * pi / 16
    x = 1190 + 82 * cos(angle)
    y = 220 + 82 * sin(angle)
    svg.append(f'  <circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="4" class="vertex"/>')

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1190" y="338" text-anchor="middle" class="label">4 segments</text>',
    '  <text x="1190" y="370" text-anchor="middle" class="label">per quadrant</text>',
    '  <text x="1190" y="410" text-anchor="middle" class="note">16 vèrtexs</text>',
    '  <text x="1045" y="462" text-anchor="middle" class="note">Més segments = corba més suau</text>',

    # Line caps.
    '  <text x="30" y="542" class="heading">Extrems de línia</text>',
])

cap_rows = [
    (650, "Arrodonit", "round"),
    (775, "Pla", "butt"),
    (900, "Quadrat", "square"),
]
for y, label, cap in cap_rows:
    svg.extend([
        f'  <text x="30" y="{y + 8}" class="label">{label}</text>',
        f'  <line x1="270" y1="{y - 44}" x2="270" y2="{y + 44}" class="endpoint"/>',
        f'  <line x1="590" y1="{y - 44}" x2="590" y2="{y + 44}" class="endpoint"/>',
        f'  <path d="M 270,{y} L 590,{y}" class="buffer-stroke-small" stroke-linecap="{cap}"/>',
        f'  <path d="M 270,{y} L 590,{y}" class="source-line"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="270" cy="{y}" r="6" class="source"/>',
        f'  <circle cx="590" cy="{y}" r="6" class="source"/>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="30" y="972" class="note">Les guies marquen els extrems originals.</text>',

    # Segment joins.
    '  <text x="730" y="542" class="heading">Unions entre segments</text>',
])

join_columns = [
    (835, "Arrodonida", "round", 4),
    (1050, "Bisellada", "bevel", 4),
    (1265, "En punta", "miter", 8),
]
for x, label, join, miter_limit in join_columns:
    path = f'M {x - 72},810 L {x},660 L {x + 72},810'
    svg.extend([
        f'  <path d="{path}" class="buffer-stroke-small" stroke-linecap="butt" stroke-linejoin="{join}" stroke-miterlimit="{miter_limit}"/>',
        f'  <path d="{path}" class="source-line"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x}" y="875" text-anchor="middle" class="label">{label}</text>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="1050" y="945" text-anchor="middle" class="note">Mateix angle, tres contorns.</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/buffer-parameters.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
